title: Irradiation-Induced Spin Bath Evolution and as-Grown Hydrogen Defects in CVD Diamond Revealed by NV-Based DEER Spectroscopy
summary: The aim of this paper is to provide the reader with a review and current state of the art of the fabrication of high T2 coherence diamond, optimised by the use of double electron-electron resonance (DEER) spectroscopy. Using DEER, we study the formation, transformation, and annealing of paramagnetic defects in as-grown CVD diamond and after post-processing. Electron irradiation leads to the formation of an additional S = 1/2 resonance in the DEER spectrum, which we consider to be a composite X ensemble.
